# uptrace_team_user (Resource)

Adds an organization user to a team. Idempotent — creating twice is a no-op server-side. The org_user_id is the ID of the OrgUser record linking the user to the organization (not the User ID).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptrace_org" "example" {
  name = "My Organization"
}

resource "uptrace_team" "example" {
  org_id = uptrace_org.example.id
  name   = "platform"
}

resource "uptrace_user" "example" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

resource "uptrace_org_user" "example" {
  org_id  = uptrace_org.example.id
  user_id = uptrace_user.example.id
  role    = "admin"
}

resource "uptrace_team_user" "example" {
  org_id      = uptrace_org.example.id
  team_id     = uptrace_team.example.id
  org_user_id = uptrace_org_user.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) Organization ID the team belongs to. Changing this forces recreation.
- `org_user_id` (String) OrgUser ID to add to the team. Changing this forces recreation.
- `team_id` (String) Team ID. Changing this forces recreation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier (equals org_user_id). Unique within the parent team.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uptrace_team_user.example 1:123:42
```
